**What did the AI write?** (paste the text, or a capture with the sensitive parts hidden)


**Which feature?** (title and summary, step-by-step guide, protect data, ask about the capture, incident report, organize the library, export draft)


**Which AI service and model?** (shown in BuzzPrint → AI)


Please don't paste API keys, passwords or personal data. BuzzPrint has no server: the text was produced by the AI service you connected, so you can also report it to that provider.
